## About
Enhanced Customs is a custom shop in Largo for people who want their car or truck to look and run their way. Air ride, static drops, lifts, off-road armor, stereo installs from mild to wild and engine swaps all come through our doors.
We stock Zone Offroad as our main line, and we're an authorized AirLift Performance and Accuair dealer and installer. Already bought your parts? We'll install them too.
As we like to put it, if you want it on your car, we can get it done. Reviewers call out the fair pricing and quick turnaround, and Frank and his crew keep a 4.5 rating from 43 Google reviews.

## Services
- Custom Air-Ride Installs: From a full blown custom air ride setup to a mild drop spring install, on new or old, import or domestic.
- Static Drops: Minor static drop to ground scraping body drops, with the car modified as needed for the drop you want.
- Off-road: Parts and services for the off-road enthusiast: leveling kits, coilover systems, suspension lifts, bumpers, armor, winches, LED lighting, steps and big brakes.
- LS Swaps: We can put an LS in almost any vehicle.
- Performance Mods: Give us a call to see how fast you can go.
- Diesel Performance Upgrades: Got boost? We work on diesel trucks too.
- Custom Car Audio: Stereo installs from mild to wild, from swapping out speakers to full-custom fiberglass enclosures.
- Everything Custom: Custom speaker pods, TVs in the headrests, custom fiberglass work, custom body work, roll-cages and so much more.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: Yes. We'll install your own parts if that's what you want.

Q: What air ride brands do you carry?
A: We stock AirLift, Accuair, Viair, AVS, SMC, Parker and more.

Q: What off-road brand do you stock?
A: Zone Offroad is our main line, and we carry and sell other brands too.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
